changelog: Merged the critic's candidate rules into the segmentation policy: forbid splitting a titled/person name from its finite verb and forbid cutting inside participial modifiers (moved these to [Never Segment] because they are dangerous in all budgets).

Demoted and described other risky comma/verb locations in [Priority Rules]: ethnonym/demonym + locative/appositive, coordinated predicates with a shared postmodifier (for/than), and verbs that take an immediate prepositional complement — these are allowed as candidates only with low rank.
Clarified [When to Segment] to reference these merged rules so the candidacy test is informed about these surface signals while keeping marking generous and ranking conservative.
